title: The Gaussian Gabor system at the critical density is a weighted lower semi frame
summary: We show that the Gaussian Gabor system at the critical density is a weighted lower semi frame, thus resolving an open question. This complements recent results showing that the system is neither a weighted frame nor admits a reproducing partner. In fact, after removing any atom from the system, suitable weights produce a complete Riesz Fischer sequence and lower semi frame.
